crossRefs.note: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day…
A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will…
The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for…
For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus…

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
translations.bsb: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
translations.kjv: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
translations.asv: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians shall worship with the Assyrians.
